derivation.reference_44_result: 44 passed with the GF1G reference consumer in a pre-GF1E court copy (9f4a23cef + reference consumer only)

separation_class_definition_frozen.EXACT_PAIR_SEPARATION: every condition state with a positive denominator is a point mass on one target state and the point-mass targets differ across states
separation_class_definition_frozen.NO_PAIR_SEPARATION: positive risk and support exist but the profile is not an exact deterministic separation (identical or partial conditional distributions)
separation_class_definition_frozen.UNDETERMINED_NO_ELIGIBLE_RISK: at least one condition state has zero eligible denominator (and no zero-support determination takes precedence)
separation_class_definition_frozen.UNDETERMINED_ZERO_SUPPORT_RISK: eligible risk exists but observed joint support is zero, or the producer typed state is a zero state; a zero count is never silently promoted and never confused with missing/unresolved
separation_class_definition_frozen.typed_refusals: inconsistent per-condition denominator vs sum(target_counts), support exceeding eligible risk, negative/noninteger counts, zero/positive cell-state inconsistency => typed rejection before any separation_class is computed

frozen_expectations.baseline_forward: EXACT_PAIR_SEPARATION, cells 00/01/10/11 = 1/0/0/1, per-condition denominators 1/1, joint eligible risk 2, joint support total 2, zero cells stay OBSERVED_ZERO_IN_SUPPORTED_RISK_SET
frozen_expectations.baseline_reverse: EXACT_PAIR_SEPARATION under REVERSE_GRANTED with roles swapped and a DIFFERENT relation object identity; same counts
frozen_expectations.intervention_R2_Y0_to_1: PAIR slot NO_ELIGIBLE_RISK (one condition has no eligible denominator); B slot reaches the frozen intervention cell set and is NO_PAIR_SEPARATION
frozen_expectations.intervention_R1_Y1_to_0: PAIR slot reaches frozen intervention cell set and is NO_PAIR_SEPARATION; B slot NO_ELIGIBLE_RISK
frozen_expectations.discovery: distinct eligible risk 1, different cells, not oracle constrained
frozen_expectations.missing_unresolved_nonresponse: typed HOLD, no separation class computed, no downstream value, generic hold retained
frozen_expectations.fully_rehashed: structurally acceptable self-authenticated TEST_ONLY relation; consumer MUST NOT grant real-source privilege; external issuer authentication is NOT expressible in the relation schema

normative_scope.relation_identity_hashes: NORMATIVE — derived from the pre-GF1E producer and real native chain; GF1E must reproduce bit-identical content_hash/object_id for the same inputs
normative_scope.consumer_result_hashes: REFERENCE_RELATIVE — the frozen contract does not fix a cross-implementation canonical result payload; GF1E must be deterministic, self-consistent and distinct across distinct semantics, but equality to the GF1G reference hash is not required
normative_scope.separation_classes_and_counts: NORMATIVE — fixed by the frozen spec and the pre-GF1E oracle, independently recomputed here
